nodes.label: Performance Benchmark Harness (tests/test_performance.py)
nodes.rationale: pytest-benchmark gates ensure upload/search pipelines stay fast; regression detection

nodes.label: Single spaCy Pass + NER Input Truncation (5000 chars)
nodes.rationale: names/locations always in header, so truncating to 5000 chars gives ~3-5x faster extraction without quality loss

nodes.label: Thread-Offload CPU/IO + Bounded Upload Semaphore
nodes.rationale: CPU/IO blocking work starves the event loop; asyncio.to_thread plus a 4-slot semaphore keeps concurrent requests responsive while SQLite sessions stay on the loop thread

nodes.label: DB FK Indexes + Single-Transaction Writes (busy_timeout=5000)
nodes.rationale: fewer internal commits means fewer fsyncs and faster queries under write contention

nodes.label: Lazy Model Loading + Search Early Termination
nodes.rationale: loading CrossEncoder/FastEmbed on first use speeds startup; skipping vector search when FTS returns nothing avoids wasted work

nodes.label: GPU Auto-Detect with CPU Fallback
nodes.rationale: probe CUDA at load time and degrade gracefully so local machines without GPUs still work

nodes.label: Deferred T5: Parallel Batch Upload Thread Pool
nodes.rationale: main bottleneck fixed by T2 thread-offload; added complexity not justified yet

nodes.label: Output-Parity Quality Guardrails
nodes.rationale: no changes to chunker params (512/64), embedding model (BAAI/bge-small-en-v1.5), rerank model (ms-marco-MiniLM-L-6-v2), LLM prompt truncation, or confidence thresholds; outputs identical before/after
